note: Photo-based composites. Original photographs are retained. Native output sizes are recorded in UPLOAD.txt; JPEG copies are format conversions of the generated PNGs.

variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: thumbnail cover for an existing 3D-print model listing.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a real user photograph. Input 2 is only a supporting brand/layout reference.
Make a polished thumbnail using the ACTUAL photograph from input 1. Its black printed cylindrical container, exposed screw threads, cotton swabs and wooden sticks, and separate black lid MUST remain photographically faithful: preserve exact proportions, view angle, positions relative to one another, black material, visible print layers, seams and small imperfections. Use the photograph itself as the foreground, do not replace it with a CAD render, do not beautify the printed surfaces, do not invent parts or change the contents. Preserve both complete objects. Only isolate/reframe the photo against a warm ivory background and add the layout.
Match input 2's restrained VeryOS design: warm ivory #F4EFE3, charcoal #252C2B, small amber #BD711F accents, generous space, thin header rule, bold Consolas/monospace typography. Copy the original VeryOS symbol and VERYOS wordmark from the upper left of input 2 faithfully; copy its small OpenSCAD icon and wordmark at upper right. Keep logos small.
Use this exact text only:
Small eyebrow: "PARAMETRIC STORAGE"
Large headline on two lines: "SCREW-TOP" and "CONTAINER"
Supporting line: "Set the size. Tune the fit."
Small footer: "EDITABLE OPENSCAD MODEL"
No dimensions, feature lists, page numbers, other text, seals, invented symbols or claims of test results.
The real photograph is the hero, not a synthesized replacement. Natural soft contact shadows, tasteful clean background. Legible at thumbnail size.
Composition: landscape aspect ratio EXACTLY 4:3, ideally 2400x1800 pixels. Header along top. Big title and supporting copy in the left third, photographed black container and lid large in the right two thirds, grounded near the bottom. Keep full cotton-swab tips, container bottom, and complete lid inside generous safe margins.
